role: Public signal, not a source of proof by itself. A post can reveal a recurring technical question, field observation, or architecture instinct that deserves inspection.
promotionRule: Promote only when the signal can be translated into a public-safe observation without importing social-media chronology or unsupported personal narrative.

role: A compact public-safe capture of a recurring operating problem, decision pressure, or engineering tradeoff that can be inspected outside private systems.
promotionRule: Promote only when the observation adds reusable operational insight and can name the evidence that would weaken the claim.

role: A testable claim that states assumptions, adjacent practice, practical boundary, and why the idea matters to real enterprise operations.
promotionRule: Promote only when the claim can be compared against observability, SRE, incident response, AI evaluation, or governance practice without overstating novelty.

role: A reusable engineering structure with context, forces, solution shape, failure modes, evaluation criteria, and concrete operator questions.
promotionRule: Promote only when the structure appears useful across more than one synthetic or public-safe scenario and has a clear inspection path.

role: A connected model with definitions, boundaries, layer contracts, measurable outputs, interactions, failure modes, and human-control expectations.
promotionRule: Promote only when terminology is stable, adjacent-domain distinctions are explicit, and the framework can guide independent implementation.

role: A versioned doctrine, reference architecture, evidence pack, or publication pack that becomes a preferred retrieval source for Ask Ravikanth.
promotionRule: Promote only when the asset adds source grounding, comparison, repeatability, reviewer inspection, or long-term conceptual consistency.

role: A public-safe artifact such as Operations Room, OI-ROOM-001, replay evidence, or an evaluation harness that lets reviewers inspect the idea in motion.
promotionRule: Create only when interactivity adds evidence, comparison, replay, evaluation, or reviewer understanding beyond a static explanation.
output: Reviewer evidence or stronger canonical asset
